description: List Motion Menu patterns. Every row is "number  slug  <role>  [tags]  · title". ROLE is where the pattern goes on a page (hero, nav, pricing, background, product, form…) — filter by it when you are building a page rather than hunting an effect. The SLUG is the permanent identity — prefer it. Filter by tag (e.g. "scroll", "webgl", "seam", "commerce"), by collection slug (e.g. "seams-handoffs"), by free-text query, or by legacy section letter. Call with no arguments to see the whole catalogue and its tag vocabulary.

role.description: WHERE IT GOES on a page — hero, nav, footer, pricing, background, gallery, product, form, stats, testimonial, cta, content, seam, chrome, type. Start here when building a page.

section.description: legacy section letter, e.g. "J" — tags supersede this
